name: loopr
description: Loopr portfolio monorepo for a local-first Expo audio app and ASP.NET Core backend.

scripts.e2e:backend: cd backend-dotnet && ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Test PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=memory AWS_REGION=us-west-2 S3_AUDIO_BUCKET_NAME=loopr-audio-local S3_PRESIGNED_UPLOAD_EXPIRES_SECONDS=900 CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8082,http://localhost:8082 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=loopr-test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=loopr-test dotnet run --no-launch-profile --project src/Loopr.Api --urls http://127.0.0.1:5102
